title: Ladakh High Pass Expedition
shortDescription: A refined Himalayan road journey through monasteries, high passes, desert valleys, and blue-water silence.
overview: Designed for travelers who want Ladakh's scale without rough edges, this route pairs iconic passes with measured acclimatization, thoughtful stays, and unhurried local experiences.
accommodation: Premium boutique hotels and heated desert camps
transportation: Private SUV with experienced mountain driver
meals: Breakfast and dinner on all trip days
weather: Clear, cold mornings and crisp evenings

itinerary.title: Arrive in Leh
itinerary.morning: Airport pickup and assisted check-in at a quiet Leh stay.
itinerary.afternoon: Rest period for acclimatization with hydration support and light snacks.
itinerary.evening: Short orientation walk and welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Leh monasteries and market
itinerary.morning: Visit Thiksey Monastery with a local guide.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore Shey Palace and slow lunch in Leh.
itinerary.evening: Sunset at Shanti Stupa followed by free time.

itinerary.title: Khardung La to Nubra
itinerary.morning: Drive across Khardung La with tea stops and photo breaks.
itinerary.afternoon: Arrive in Nubra Valley and settle into camp.
itinerary.evening: Dune walk near Hunder and relaxed camp dinner.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong
itinerary.morning: Scenic valley drive along the Shyok route.
itinerary.afternoon: Reach Pangong and check into lakeside accommodation.
itinerary.evening: Golden-hour lake walk with hot beverages.

faq.question: Is this trip safe for first-time high-altitude travelers?
faq.answer: Yes, the route starts with acclimatization time in Leh and keeps the first two days deliberately light.

faq.question: Can the stay category be upgraded?
faq.answer: Yes, premium and luxury stay upgrades can be quoted depending on dates and availability.

reviews.name: Rhea Kapoor
reviews.text: Every transfer, pause, and stay felt considered. Ladakh was wild, but the planning was calm.

title: Bali Slow Luxury Escape
shortDescription: Rice terraces, private pool villas, cliff sunsets, and soft adventure paced for couples.
overview: A polished island itinerary that gives Bali room to breathe, with intimate stays, cultural hosting, and scenic transfers planned around comfortable travel days.

meals: Daily breakfast and two curated dinners
weather: Warm tropical days with occasional showers

itinerary.title: Arrive in Ubud
itinerary.afternoon: Check into a villa near rice fields.

itinerary.afternoon: Rice terrace lunch and spa time.
itinerary.evening: Free evening at a recommended restaurant.

itinerary.title: Waterfalls and Sidemen

itinerary.afternoon: Continue to Sidemen for valley views.

faq.question: Is this suitable for a honeymoon?

faq.question: Can vegetarian food be arranged?
faq.answer: Yes, vegetarian and vegan preferences can be shared before confirmation.

reviews.name: Dev and Isha
reviews.text: The balance between privacy and discovery was exactly what we wanted for our honeymoon.
